network_status.network: Libro Ponte sul Trigno – cronaca del crollo gennaio 2003 e ricostruzione
network_status.summary_it: La cronologia tecnica identifica cinquanta ore di pioggia, l'incrinatura durante la piena la sera del 24 gennaio e il crollo alle 12:58 del 25 gennaio 2003, ma non riporta livello o portata del Trigno. Gli orari documentati restano separati da una misura idrometrica assente.
network_status.summary_en: The technical chronology identifies fifty hours of rainfall, cracking during the flood on the evening of 24 January and collapse at 12:58 on 25 January 2003, but reports no Trigno stage or discharge. The documented times remain separate from the absent hydrometric measurement.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
